name: starter-p5-team-otr-dedicated-annual
about: Starter P5 "On the road, in figures" on the opening-team-otr-dedicated-annual brief (the owner's copy rating, 2026-11-12).

brief.subject: Class A team drivers, dedicated OTR

subject_matter.in_our_words: Teams stay together; we do not split a good pair.

recipe.name: On the road, in figures
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with one of the brief's own figures as evidence rather than a promise (the pay, or the miles), and put a second on the second line (the home time, or the bonus), so the two read side by side. If the brief states only one figure, the second line is the plainest fact beside it. Never round, never add a figure.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our truck driving on {road} through {setting}, {viewpoint}, {light}, {season}, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: Silvicom Inc pays Class A teams $95,000 to $110,000 a year. Dedicated dry van freight, coast to coast. We keep good pairs together. Age 23+.
en.headline: Dedicated OTR teams

es.primary_text: Silvicom Inc paga a equipos Clase A de $95,000 a $110,000 al año. Carga en caja seca, cuenta dedicada, de costa a costa. Aquí no separamos una buena pareja. Mayores de 23.
es.headline: Equipos OTR dedicados

en.primary_text: Drop and hook dry van, coast to coast. Your team runs OTR together, and Silvicom Inc does not split a good pair. Up to $110,000 a year. Class A, 23+.
